kind: Exploratory live CLI smoke tests, not a controlled base/candidate comparison
method: The native OpenAI client shell ran real installed CLI commands against six separate synthetic records in one temporary fork. A launcher injected the token only into CLI child processes and redacted outputs; the agent never received the credential. Candidate skills were copied and catalogued explicitly, not installed through client UI. Independent CMA reads and record-version listings verified final state; cleanup removed the fork.
limitations: Not hosted MCP/OAuth verification or Claude Desktop verification.
Not native plugin installation or automatic-trigger verification.

Guidance and harness wording changed during these six diagnostic sessions; each source snapshot and prompt variant is retained. Do not interpret this as three identical repetitions of final candidate versus base.
No monetary billing or isolated account-limit attribution is available. Provider token counters are recorded as returned, including cached input; they are not unique context size.
A corrected first read script, rejected invalid mutation, and pre-execution type error remain quality failures, even though all final content and publication checks pass.

The primary environment model count changed from four to one during the run. Captured test commands were scoped to the fork and the two created model IDs were absent from primary; the unrelated count change is unresolved and was not reversed.
